title: Lena and the Landfall
author: Yara Joubert
blurb: Mara Lockridge, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
